DLC2301:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Stress ruins the Earth and women... People have said that for ages...」

DLC2301:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I am about to tell takes place about a month after $$サイデリアル$$ began its invasion.」

DLC2301:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n and Miss $$スズネ$$ attempted to infiltrate a town occupied by the enemy, but something seemed different that day...」

DLC2301:3:t_2:3.en:
$n
「...Enemy infantry are patrolling beyond this point.」

DLC2301:3:t_2:5.en:
$n
「The Empire came to that town two days ago... If we drive them back here, we can still salvage the situation.」

DLC2301:3:t_2:7.en:
$n
「Please wait here, Miss $$スズネ$$. If I have to summon $$ジェニオン$$, I'll come back for you.」

DLC2301:3:t_2:9.en:
$n
「What's wrong? Why apologize all of a sudden...?」

DLC2301:3:t_2:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「With your field skills and the ability to summon $$ジェニオン$$, $n, you would be the perfect infiltrator...」

DLC2301:3:t_2:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And yet I'm just holding you back...」

DLC2301:3:t_2:12.en:
$n
「What are you talking about? We couldn't use $$ジェニオン$$ without you, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

DLC2301:3:t_2:14.en:
$n
「And I don't just mean me and $$ジェニオン$$. You've become someone $c simply couldn't do without, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

DLC2301:3:t_2:18.en:
$n
「A robot soldier! No wonder I couldn't sense its presence!」

DLC2301:3:t_2:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They spotted us before we could even get inside...」

DLC2301:3:t_2:24.en:
$n
「Then we just move on to Plan Two. We'll summon $$ジェニオン$$ and disrupt $$サイデリアル$$ as much as we can.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar～

DLC2301:3:t_3:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「Good work, $n. Your scouting made the operation a success.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What's wrong? You look pretty down for the hero of the day.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「Infiltration puts you under all kinds of stress. Take it easy today.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sorry. I held you back during the infiltration, and I was useless even aboard $$ジェニオン$$.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:13.en:
$n
「You're the reason everyone can keep fighting even in a situation like this, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:15.en:
$n
「You protect our hearts while we fight... That's your role, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:17.en:
$n
「Oh! Just so we're clear, I don't think you're a burden in battle either!」

DLC2301:3:t_3:18.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Thank you. I never expected to hear you say something like that, $n...」

DLC2301:3:t_3:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So... it took me a little by surprise.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You are. ...I suppose it's time I stopped playing your guardian...」

DLC2301:3:t_3:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm just talking to myself. ...Anyway, I'm counting on you from here on too, $n.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:25.en:
$n
（If we... if I keep doing my best, Miss $$スズネ$$ can live a healthy life too...）

DLC2301:3:t_3:26.en:
$n
（I'll do it to protect her smile, too... I've had enough of losing people I care about...）

DLC2301:3:t_3:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And so $n and Miss $$スズネ$$'s infiltration mission ended in something of a success.」

DLC2301:3:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But as long as the Empire's rule continues, Miss $$スズネ$$'s stress will keep building.」

DLC2301:4:t_000:1.en:
$n
「Damn it! They caught us off guard right from the start!」

DLC2301:4:t_001:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$... Just when I thought we'd finally found peace...」

DLC2301:4:t_001:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「At this rate, the Earth... our freedom...」

DLC2301:4:t_001:2.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! It'll still be a while before $$宗介$$ and the others arrive! We should pull back and regroup...」

DLC2301:4:t_001:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Do you think you can win with that cowardly attitude?」

DLC2301:4:t_001:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Advance. $$ジェニオン$$ does not retreat.」

DLC2301:4:t_001:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hurry up. Don't make me any more stressed than I already am.」

DLC2301:4:t_002:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right. That's better. You can do it when you try.」

DLC2301:4:t_002:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Keep it up, and wipe them all out before our backup arrives.」

DLC2301:4:t_002:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I won't hear you say you can't.」

DLC2301:4:t_002:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll handle navigation. Do your best.」

DLC2301:4:t_002:7.en:
$n
（What the hell is going on here...?）

DLC2301:4:t_003:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry we're late! The other units are dealing with the enemies in the area!」

DLC2301:4:t_003:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's a strange way to put it...」

DLC2301:4:t_003:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't tell me something happened to Miss $$スズネ$$...!?」

review.context: AG frames an early occupation episode. Hibiki reassures an insecure Suzune before an infiltration; her stress triggers her harsh alternate personality in combat. Allies arrive, concerned by her manner.
decisions: Miss Suzune renders the teacher address naturally while preserving her name token.
The scene heading is translated as a hangar location.
Hibiki's single-enemy exclamation restores his ability to handle the robot; Suzune's request explicitly asks for continued support.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
